items.title: How a real-time auction works
steps: A page loads with an ad slot
The seller sends a bid request
The ad shows and is counted
items.why: The request goes out, bids come back, and the winner is shown.

items.title: How a programmatic guaranteed deal runs
steps: The buyer and seller agree volume and price
The deal is set up with a deal ID
The buyer’s ads are delivered automatically
Delivery is tracked against the agreement
The deal is reconciled and billed
items.why: The terms are agreed first, then delivery is automated and checked.
